coreAtributes.authorTag: Faintly raised lettering on each pad reads "Official Enforcer Issue, MFD by DSG Threadworks."
coreAtributes.name: Enforcer's tactical elbow pads
coreAtributes.description: A pair of hard plastic plates riveted to elbow pads made from shock absorbing foam. They attach to the wearer's elbows via adjustable straps

replacementText.self: [npc.Name] slip the tactical elbow pads over [npc.her] elbows and tighten the straps.
replacementText.other: [npc.Name] slip the tactical elbow pads over [npc2.namePos] elbows and tighten the straps.
replacementText.otherRough: [npc.Name] stuff [npc2.namePos] legs through the tactical elbow pads and hastily tighten the straps.

displacementText.self: [npc.Name] loosen the straps on [npc.her] tactical elbow pads and slip them off.
displacementText.other: [npc.Name] loosen the straps on [npc2.namePos] tactical elbow pads and slip them off.
displacementText.otherRough: [npc.Name] tear at the straps on [npc2.namePos] tactical elbow pads until they're loose enough and toss them aside.
